# ImageGet

> ImageGet is an iOS and iPadOS app that saves photos and videos from the web straight to your photo library. Open Instagram Batch Download to keep photos, carousels and Reels; paste any web page URL to collect every image on the page; or use Video Download for YouTube Shorts, X (Twitter), Facebook Reels, Instagram Reels, bilibili, xHamster, EPORNER and xVideos. One tap, everything saved.

ImageGet - Downloader From Web is available on the App Store (App Store ID 878190312), rated 17+.

## Product

- [ImageGet home](https://imageget.rayyao.com/): How the app works, features, free plan and Premium.
- [Supported sites](https://imageget.rayyao.com/supported-sites.html): Every site and platform the app can save from, listed by the names shown in the app.
- [How it works](https://imageget.rayyao.com/#how): The three-step flow — log in or paste a link, review what was found, save to your photo library.
- [Features](https://imageget.rayyao.com/#features): Batch download, size filtering, full-screen preview, background operation, built-in browser.
- [Premium and pricing](https://imageget.rayyao.com/#pricing): What the free plan includes and what Premium unlocks.
